channels.name: general
channels.topic: Sample team · not real people · the four sample projects

messages.text: Build review Thursday 2 PM. One update per project: truck, quadcopter, rocket, classifier.
The lab printer has a new nozzle. The longer quadcopter arms are printing now.
Classifier is at 74% after 15 epochs. Cat vs dog is still the big mix-up.

channels.name: rc-truck
channels.topic: Sample team · not real people · RC truck slalom

messages.text: v1 rolled over on the sharp turn at 2.1 m/s. Track is too narrow for that CoG height.
v2 has the wider track and lower centre of mass. Finished the slalom in 8.6 s.
And the autopilot did it in 7.4 s with no cones hit. Nice.
At 2.2 m/s it's 5.9 s but it clips a cone. Retrain on faster laps before we push it?

channels.name: quadcopter
channels.topic: Sample team · not real people · quadcopter frame and flights

messages.text: v5 with 5 in props: clear to fly, thrust 14.1x its weight, about 10.9 min of hover.
Tried 7 in props on v6 and they overlap by 22 mm. Needs longer arms.
Two of the 7 in props arrived chipped, sending them back.
@You is v7 with the 320 mm wheelbase ready for a hover test this week?

channels.name: rocket
channels.topic: Sample team · not real people · rocket fins and stability

messages.text: Smaller fins (36 mm span) dropped the margin to 0.84 cal on v2. That would tumble.
v3 is back to 1.25 cal. Still marginal in a gust.
Can we keep the small fins and lengthen the body instead? Aim for 1.5 cal or more.

channels.name: image-classifier
channels.topic: Sample team · not real people · image classifier accuracy

messages.text: 15-epoch run is done: 74% on the 1,000 validation images.
Ships are best at 87%. Cats are worst at 54%, mostly called dogs.
I'll try crops and flips next and see if cat vs dog improves.
Nice work on the truck demo yesterday.
Thanks! Albie did most of the talking.
Can you bring the rocket numbers to Thursday's review?
Sending you the hover log from the v5 test.
Got it, hover throttle around 27% looks right.
